_doku: Statement-currency hand table (2026-09-26). Read by lib/statement-currency-hand-table.js inside _convertSnapshotToUSD (pull-yahoo.js).
Row = a ticker whose Yahoo financialCurrency (right for financialData: revenueTTM, ebitda) is NOT the currency of its statement series (annual.*, timeseries.*).
Petrobras and Embraer file their statements in US dollars; Yahoo labels the company BRL, so the pull divided USD figures by the BRL rate again (~5x too small).
The statement series then get factor 1 (USD) instead of the BRL factor ONLY while the error is visible: Yahoo still says yahooFinancialCurrency

AND latest annual revenue / revenueTTM is nearer the reporting FX factor than 1 (USD statements next to a BRL TTM). Otherwise nothing changes and the snapshot carries meta._statementCcyHandTableStale.
Same-issuer legs carry the byte-identical raw statement series (checked on CI run 36227380588), so one filing proves every leg of the issuer.
Optional series: annual restricts the USD correction to annual.*; omitted means annual.* and timeseries.*. MODEC quarters remain JPY.
